messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: routing-policy-error-high /v1/generate error-rate > 10% in eu-west1 (last 5m). AlertID: RTE-20260315-01 - https://alerts.redwood.internal/RTE-20260315-01

maria (oncall): taking this. paging @sam and @jin. :phone:

sam (sre): on it. quick status? customer impact?

maria (oncall): 5xxs and strange tokenization errors reported by customers hitting variant pinned routes. error rate spiked ~11.4% for eu-west1, latency p95 up from 120ms to ~1.2s. ~50k affected requests in last 30m.

olivia (product): Carmen, any customer reports?

carmen (cs): Got 3 bump messages from enterprise accounts in EU complaining about garbled outputs and malformed JSON from the model. They flagged business-critical endpoints.

jin (ml-infra): quick hypothesis: staged rollout of v3-alpha started 30m ago. Smart routing fallback policy seems to be sending traffic back to the pinned variant in a sticky way. v3-alpha uses a new tokenizer/profile that is incompatible with the stable inference path in some edge hosts -> malformed outputs. I'm seeing route pin + fallback TTL = 24h in the policy.

sam (sre): can you show logs that indicate variant mismatch?

jin (ml-infra): paste logs: ```
2026-03-15T10:11:02Z route_decision: user=acct-142 variant=v3-alpha -> host=eu-worker-08 fallback=sticky->host=eu-worker-02
2026-03-15T10:11:03Z model_init: variant=v3-alpha tokenizer=tok-v3 loaded OK
2026-03-15T10:11:05Z infer: host=eu-worker-02 variant=v2.2.5 tokenizer=tok-v2 -> response: tokenization_error: unexpected_token
```

maria (oncall): so traffic is routed to hosts expecting v2 but annotated sticky fallback returns v3 headers -> mismatch. That would produce garbage.

sam (sre): immediate plan: 1) pause staged rollout 2) evict sticky affinity for eu-west1 3) force traffic back to stable variant v2.2.5 4) lower fallback TTL and remove sticky policy until we confirm hosts are compatible.

maria (oncall): doing step 1 now. running: ```/redwoodctl rollout pause --service=text-gen --env=prod --selector=staged=v3-alpha```

deploy-bot: rollback/pause command acknowledged. Rollout pause job started (job id: PJ-4432).

maria (oncall): step 2: evicting sticky routes for region. ```/redwoodctl routes evict --policy=route-pin --region=eu-west1 --confirm```

deploy-bot: routes evict request accepted. eviction in progress.

jin (ml-infra): while eviction runs I'm going to adjust smart-fallback TTL to short so any sticky sessions decay: ```/redwoodctl routing update --policy=smart-fallback --region=eu-west1 --ttl=30s```

deploy-bot: routing policy updated (smart-fallback, eu-west1): TTL=30s.

sam (sre): step 3: shifting traffic to stable variant now. ```/redwoodctl traffic shift --service=text-gen --region=eu-west1 --to-variant=v2.2.5 --weight=100```

deploy-bot: traffic shift applied. Drain started on v3-alpha hosts.

maria (oncall): monitoring dashboard: p50/p95 latencies starting to return toward baseline. 5xx rate trending down.

carmen (cs): notifying the affected customers now with a short blurb: "We observed degraded outputs due to an experimental model rollout and have reverted to the stable model. We're investigating and will follow up with details."

olivia (product): good. we need to scope blast radius: which customers had route-pin to v3-alpha? jin, can you dump list?

jin (ml-infra): exporting pinned routes: ```curl -s 'https://controlplane/api/pinned_routes?variant=v3-alpha&region=eu-west1' | jq '.pins | length, .pins[].account'``` -> returns 12 pinned accounts (IDs listed). I'll push to CS.

sam (sre): check for loop behavior: are we seeing any repeated fallback handoffs (host -> fallback host -> back)?

jin (ml-infra): yes, trace shows oscillation for some sessions due to sticky fallback that prefers previous host affinity even after the host evicted. Example trace: ```host A -> fallback to host B (v3) -> routing policy tries to route back to host A (v2) -> fallback returns host B again``` that's causing repeated tokenization mismatch. Eviction + TTL change should break the loop.

sam (sre): thumbs up. Also open a mitigation ticket: MIT-2026-03-15-14. I'll take short-term ownership for infra changes.

maria (oncall): monitoring: error rate now down to 1.1% in eu-west1. Not fully baseline but much better.

deploy-bot: rollback complete: service=text-gen rolled back to v2.2.5 in eu-west1 (deploy id: DPL-9901).

carmen (cs): sent initial notifications to 12 pinned customers and one broader notice to enterprise list. Awaiting responses.

olivia (product): next: Root cause & follow-ups. Jin to own host compatibility check; Sam to own routing policy review & a short-term guard; Maria to do incident timeline and ops-runbook update; Carmen/CS to handle customer comms; I'll own postmortem.

jin (ml-infra): immediate follow-ups: run host compatibility scan across eu-west1 workers for tokenizer builds and model runtime flags, and run quick canary of v3-alpha on a small isolated pool (no pins) once compatibility fixed.

sam (sre): also recommend adding auto-guard: if variant header mismatch detected, do not use sticky fallback; prefer immediate stable variant. I'll file infra PR.

maria (oncall): handing incident off to sam for long-running mitigation. I'm CIing the runbook notes into the incident doc. Next oncall is @olivia in 2.5 hours — please take if needed. :white_check_mark:

sam (sre): acknowledged. I'll coordinate a brief postmortem and link to MIT ticket.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident RTE-20260315-01 mitigated (status: recovered). Postmortem owner: olivia (product). Severity: Sev2.

maria (oncall): final note: please add test to rollout pipeline to assert tokenizer/runtime compatibility before traffic shift (blocking). That should prevent variant/host mismatches.

olivia (product): adding to roadmap and will assign. thanks everyone. :pray:

carmen (cs): will follow up with affected customers with a timeline and next steps once we have root cause.

sam (sre): logging MIT ticket and scheduling a 1h sticky-session-routes sync tomorrow.

maria (oncall): handing off. all clear from my side.

jen (not on thread): (reaction) :thumbsup:"
